userJourneys.understandsImmediately: The user immediately recognizes this is a hiking map application for Israel. The map shows clustered markers and the sidebar displays trail cards.
userJourneys.unclear: Why the list reports 1,783 trails while the map only displays 889 pins (no immediate explanation that 894 trails lack verified/probable coordinates). On mobile, the trail list is hidden behind a bottom button.
userJourneys.unnecessaryEffort: Mobile users must discover and tap the bottom floating pill to see the trail list.
userJourneys.missingInfo: No quick onboarding tooltip or headline explaining the coverage scope (1,783 trails, verified coordinates, keyless OSM map).
userJourneys.wrongInterpretationRisk: Users might assume the app only covers 889 trails if they only look at the map.
userJourneys.especiallyGood: Instant loading, crisp Hebrew typography, and immediate responsiveness.

userJourneys.understandsImmediately: Branding (Compass logo + 'TrailMap - מפת מסלולי הטיולים של ישראל') makes the purpose 100% self-evident.
userJourneys.unclear: Whether this is an official governmental app, a commercial site, or an open-source community tool.
userJourneys.missingInfo: A brief 1-line mission statement in the header or footer explaining that all content is independently curated and open-access.
userJourneys.especiallyGood: Clean, independent aesthetic without intrusive ads or corporate branding.

userJourneys.understandsImmediately: Users can immediately filter by region, difficulty, water, or popular categories, or search by name.
userJourneys.unclear: Selecting 'קשה / מאתגרת' returns 0 results because the dropdown value ('קשה') mismatches the data attribute ('מאתגרת').
userJourneys.unnecessaryEffort: Cannot filter by route type (circular vs linear) or duration.
userJourneys.missingInfo: Route type filter (מעגלי / הלוך-חזור) and duration range filter.
userJourneys.redundantInfo: Jerusalem sub-districts occupy 10 separate entries in the top 30 regions dropdown.
userJourneys.wrongInterpretationRisk: Users looking for challenging trails will conclude TrailMap has zero hard hikes in the entire country.
userJourneys.especiallyGood: Water quick toggle ('רחצה במים') and Near Me geolocation button.

userJourneys.understandsImmediately: Distance, duration, difficulty, and water indicators can be compared across cards in the list.
userJourneys.unclear: Which trails are circular vs out-and-back cannot be compared without opening each trail modal.
userJourneys.unnecessaryEffort: Clicking into multiple modals and switching to Tab 2 to check route type.
userJourneys.missingInfo: Route type ('מעגלי' / 'הלוך-חזור') is completely missing from TrailCard.
userJourneys.wrongInterpretationRisk: Users may assume an 8km trail is circular when it is actually an 8km point-to-point hike requiring two cars.
userJourneys.especiallyGood: Favorites heart button allows bookmarking and filtering to create a custom comparison list.

userJourneys.understandsImmediately: Tapping 'פתח מסלול' on the card or clicking a map pin opens a modal with comprehensive information.
userJourneys.unclear: Tabs are labeled 'סקירה ומסלול', 'מידע שימושי', 'הגעה וחניה', 'מקור הנתונים'—user must guess which tab holds parking or equipment.
userJourneys.unnecessaryEffort: Must click through multiple tabs to assemble a full logistical picture.
userJourneys.redundantInfo: Distance, duration, and difficulty are shown in the top grid AND repeated in the practical info tab table.
userJourneys.especiallyGood: Full modal backdrop blur, Escape key support, and seamless focus management.

userJourneys.step: F. Understanding whether the trail is suitable
userJourneys.understandsImmediately: Top metrics grid immediately clarifies distance, duration, difficulty, and water suitability.
userJourneys.unclear: Whether a 4x4 vehicle is required is not visible in the top metrics or header; it is buried in Tab 3.
userJourneys.unnecessaryEffort: Must navigate to Tab 3 to check if a 4x4 vehicle is necessary.
userJourneys.missingInfo: No prominent 4x4 badge in the modal header or quick metrics bar.
userJourneys.wrongInterpretationRisk: A family in a sedan may review the trail, see 'בינונית' and 'מים', and decide to go without realizing a 4x4 is required to reach the start point.
userJourneys.especiallyGood: Truthful representation of water: explicitly distinguishes 'רחצה אפשרית' from 'רחצה אסורה' and 'מים עונתיים'.

userJourneys.step: G. Understanding access, parking, water, shade, difficulty, duration
userJourneys.understandsImmediately: Water and duration are immediately clear. Detailed driving and parking descriptions in Tab 3 are exceptionally rich.
userJourneys.unclear: Shade information is buried inside Tab 2 table, despite being a primary safety concern in Israeli summer.
userJourneys.unnecessaryEffort: Switching between Tab 1, Tab 2, and Tab 3 to collect shade, parking, and route structure.
userJourneys.missingInfo: Shade indicator in the top metrics grid.
userJourneys.wrongInterpretationRisk: None—unknowns are presented honestly as 'לא צוין במקור' rather than inventing false claims.
userJourneys.especiallyGood: Nuanced access instructions: explicitly explains when sedans park in lot A while 4x4 can continue to lot B.

userJourneys.understandsImmediately: Waze and Google Maps external action buttons are prominent and functional.
userJourneys.unclear: Direct 'נווט' button on the TrailCard launches navigation directly to coordinate without alerting the user to read parking directions first.
userJourneys.missingInfo: Parking coordinate vs trail coordinate differentiation.
userJourneys.wrongInterpretationRisk: Clicking 'נווט' on the card can navigate drivers straight into inaccessible wadi tracks rather than the designated parking lot.
userJourneys.especiallyGood: Suppresses broken navigation links when coordinates are missing and displays clear warning.

userJourneys.step: I. Returning to list/map and finding another trail
userJourneys.understandsImmediately: Closing modal returns user to exact scroll position and map coordinates.
userJourneys.especiallyGood: Zero reload, zero map re-render, map state and active filters remain perfectly preserved.

homeScreenReview.desktopImpression: Clean, utilitarian, nature-themed split-screen discovery tool. Clear visual hierarchy with dark nature-900 header, white filter bar, 560px card sidebar, and full-bleed MapLibre map on left.
homeScreenReview.mobileImpression: Map-first interface with floating action button. Very clean, but hides the rich 1,783-trail database until the user interacts with the bottom sheet toggle.
homeScreenReview.visualHierarchy: Strong. Brand -> Search -> Filters -> List/Map -> Cards. The primary action (search / explore map) is evident within 3 seconds.
homeScreenReview.aboveTheFoldDensity: Well balanced on desktop. On 1920x1080, the 560px sidebar is slightly narrow relative to the massive map expanse.
homeScreenReview.mapUtility: The map is functionally active, responsive, and hardware-accelerated. Cluster numbers provide an immediate heatmap of trail density in Israel (Galilee, Judean Hills, Desert).

searchReview.discoverability: Top-center in Header on all screens; auto-focus and clear button provided.
searchReview.feedback: Instantaneous (<5ms). Result count badge in list header updates in real-time.
searchReview.exactQuery: Exceptional. 'נחל חיק נחל אורן' immediately returns the exact trail.
searchReview.niqqudHandling: Robust. 'נַחַל עַמּוּד' normalizes and matches identically to 'נחל עמוד'.

naturalLanguageWeakness.queryNearJerusalem: 'מסלול ליד ירושלים' returns 0 results because 'ליד' is treated as a required substring.
naturalLanguageWeakness.queryWith4x4: 'מסלול עם 4x4' returns 0 results because 'עם' is not in the text.
naturalLanguageWeakness.queryWithoutWater: 'מסלול ללא מים' returns trails WITH water because it matches 'מסלול' AND 'מים'.
naturalLanguageWeakness.substringOvermatch: 'ארמו' matches 199 trails because 4-letter fuzzy logic matches 'רמו' inside 'מכתש רמון'.

searchReview.zeroResultState: Helpful message ('לא נמצאו מסלולים מתאימים. נסה לשנות את מילות החיפוש או לאפס מסננים').

visibleFilters: Trails in this area (Viewport bounds toggle)
9 Category tags (מים, תצפיות, פריחה, ירוק, מדברי, משפחות, עתיקות, אתגרי, מערות)

criticalFilterBug.issue: Difficulty dropdown value 'קשה' matches 0 trails because the dataset records challenging trails as 'מאתגרת' (60 trails). Selecting 'קשה / מאתגרת' returns an empty result set.

missingFilterableAttributes: Route Type (מעגלי / הלוך-חזור) - 1,579 trails have this attribute, but it cannot be filtered.
4x4 Requirement - 27 trails require 4x4, 29 have conditional access, but cannot be filtered.
Duration / Distance Range - No slider or bucket filter (<2 hours, full day, <5km, >10km).
filterReview.combinability: Predictable AND logic. Reset button appears automatically when any filter is active.

trailCardReview.canAnswerShouldIOpen: Partially. A user can judge region, distance, duration, difficulty, water presence, and map coordinate status. But they cannot know if the hike is circular, if it requires a 4x4, or if there is shade.
trailCardReview.placeholderSaturation: 1,781 / 1,783 cards (99.9%) display generic gradient placeholders. While designed nicely, it creates visual monotony across large lists.
trailCardReview.tapAffordance: Entire card is clickable, plus dedicated 'פתח מסלול' button and 'נווט' button.

tabArchitecture.overview: Clear summary, extracted landmark tags, and structured walkthrough.
tabArchitecture.practical: Key logistical table. However, it repeats distance/duration/difficulty from the top grid.
tabArchitecture.access: Crucial driving, parking, public transit, and vehicle requirements.
tabArchitecture.source: Transparent archival markdown record with extraction provenance.

trailDetailReview.truthfulNegatives: Honest representation: 'לא צוינה מגבלת רכב מיוחדת במקור' prevents false claims of standard car suitability.
buriedItems: Walking type is buried in Tab 2.

navigationReview.googleMapsIntegration: Functional external links without any Google API dependency.
navigationReview.directNavHazard: Card 'נווט' button launches navigation to trail coordinate, bypassing vital parking notes and 4x4 restrictions.

mapReview.engine: MapLibre GL JS keyless with OpenStreetMap Standard tiles.
mapReview.missingHandling: 894 unlocated trails strictly excluded from map GeoJSON—no fabricated coordinates.
mapReview.clustering: Hardware-accelerated circle clustering with expansion zoom on click.
mapReview.statePreservation: Map center and zoom survive opening and closing the detail modal.

observations: Header search placeholder (45 chars) overflows and truncates on 375px width.
FilterBar horizontal scroll lacks visual affordance (subtle gradient mask needed).
Touch targets on card buttons (36px) are slightly smaller than 44px recommended for mobile thumbs.
Bottom sheet (80vh) performs smoothly with native gesture feel.
On 1920x1080, the fixed 560px sidebar occupies only 29% of screen width, leaving vast empty map space.
Two-column grid inside 560px leaves cards at ~250px width, causing tight badge wrapping.

contentUXReview.conciseness: Factual summaries are short (average 100-140 characters), direct, and filler-free.
contentUXReview.truthfulness: Zero hallucinated claims or fabricated narrative prose.
contentUXReview.clarity: High. Sentences follow natural Hebrew grammar.

accessibilityReview.keyboardNavigation: Fully operational with Escape modal close, focus trap, and focus restoration.
accessibilityReview.colorContrast: All core text and badges exceed WCAG AA (Header input text-white on nature-800 achieves >10:1).
accessibilityReview.rtlCompliance: dir='rtl' declared on html; right-aligned layout and reversed direction arrows.

frictionMap.userProblem: Selecting 'קשה / מאתגרת' in difficulty filter returns 0 trails.
frictionMap.userImpact: Users looking for difficult hikes are falsely told there are none in the entire database.
frictionMap.evidence: FilterBar.tsx sets value='קשה', but data stores difficulty='מאתגרת' (60 trails).
frictionMap.suggestedDirection: Update difficulty filter check in search-utils.ts or option value to match 'מאתגרת'.

frictionMap.userProblem: Route type ('מעגלי' vs 'הלוך-חזור') is not displayed on TrailCard.
frictionMap.userImpact: Users must click into every modal to find out if a hike is circular or requires two cars.
frictionMap.evidence: 1,579 trails have route type defined, but TrailCard.tsx only displays distance, duration, and difficulty.
frictionMap.suggestedDirection: Add route type icon badge to the quick metrics bar of TrailCard.tsx.

frictionMap.userProblem: No 4x4 warning on TrailCard or Modal Header.
frictionMap.userImpact: Hikers in standard cars can drive to remote trailheads and get stranded or turned away.
frictionMap.evidence: 27 trails require 4x4, but TrailCard displays zero vehicle indication.
frictionMap.suggestedDirection: Add an amber/red '4x4 בלבד' badge to TrailCard and a warning callout in the modal top metrics.

frictionMap.userProblem: Direct 'נווט' button on TrailCard bypasses vital parking and access directions.
frictionMap.userImpact: Navigates drivers to remote trail coordinates rather than the designated parking lot or passenger car lot.
frictionMap.evidence: Birkat Tzfira coordinates point to wadi bed, while passenger cars must park at Tzfira Night Camp 1.5km away.
frictionMap.suggestedDirection: For trails with specific parking or 4x4 restrictions, clicking 'נווט' on the card should open the modal's Access tab.

frictionMap.userProblem: Conversational / natural language queries fail ('מסלול ליד ירושלים', 'מסלול עם 4x4').
frictionMap.userImpact: Users typing common natural phrases receive empty or misleading results.
frictionMap.evidence: Search requires every word to match verbatim. Prepositions ('ליד', 'עם', 'ללא') cause total failure.
frictionMap.suggestedDirection: Strip common Hebrew stop-words ('מסלול', 'ליד', 'עם', 'של') before matching.

frictionMap.userProblem: 99.9% of trails (1,781/1,783) display identical gradient placeholder banners.
frictionMap.userImpact: Browsing large lists feels visually monotonous and does not convey the real scenery or terrain.
frictionMap.evidence: withImages count is 2 across the entire 1,783-trail dataset.
frictionMap.suggestedDirection: Explore open/community photo integration, elevation sparklines, or terrain maps in card headers.

frictionMap.userProblem: Region dropdown is cluttered by 10 Jerusalem micro-neighborhoods, cutting off other major regions.
frictionMap.userImpact: Users cannot select major regions like Samaria, Lakhish, or Dead Sea from the dropdown.
frictionMap.suggestedDirection: Consolidate 91 region strings into 12-15 macro-regions with hierarchical sub-regions.

frictionMap.userProblem: Search input placeholder (45 characters) is clipped on 375px screens.
frictionMap.userImpact: Looks unpolished on compact phones like iPhone SE.
frictionMap.suggestedDirection: Shorten placeholder on mobile to 'חיפוש מסלול, אזור, מים...'.
